title: chore(objectui): move the console pin to b9814b334d8a (objectui main tip, carrying objectui#12270 and objectui#11773)
body:
Fixes #23392
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `1fb1ced36243` to `b9814b334d8a`, objectui `main` at `b9814b334d8aebac43dd2b04a2003963aec3cc6e`. I re-read that commit with `git ls-remote https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui.git refs/heads/main` when the work started, and it was still the tip. The hop carries objectui#12270 (PR objectui#12350, `b434f5f47`) and objectui#11773 (PR objectui#12351, `b9814b334`, the tip itself). It also carries objectui's dependency move to `@objectstack/*` `^18.0.0-next.0` (objectui#12030, `c5406c201`).

The maintainer's order, verbatim: 「先处理这个，虽然是 p2, 23392」. The card's filing order, verbatim: 「开, 并且你负责派发这张卡，然后再下班」.

**Tier:** no governed surface (no `GOVERNED_SURFACES` row in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` matches a path here). 26 files, +527/−131.

## The hop: 36 objectui commits, 397 paths, all on objectui `main`

- `git merge-base --is-ancestor 1fb1ced36243 b9814b334d8a` exits 0 in the sibling checkout. `git rev-list --count` reads 36.
- `b434f5f47` and `b9814b334` are both in the range. The ancestry check for `b434f5f47` also exits 0. Both readings are exit 0, which proves itself even in a shallow checkout.
- The checkout is shallow. The bump script's `--check-walkable` probe said the range walks completely, with no deepen.

## Console Pin Gate steps, run locally (each exited 0)

1. Client closure: `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client...` (34 tasks).
2. `scripts/build-console.sh` at the new pin. It reported:
   - bundle canary `import/jobs` present;
   - exactly one zod version literal (`{major:4,minor:6,patch:5}`);
   - "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it";
   - "Shipped the tracked sdui.manifest.json (recorded at objectui@b9814b334d8a, this pin)".
3. Dist presence assert: `index.html`, `assets/` and the `.objectui-sha` stamp are present, 64292 KB.
4. `pnpm check:console-sha`: "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@b9814b334d8a)".
5. `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp`: "the dist carries this tree's copy, and not the published one".

I ran the build twice. The second run came after the manifest regeneration and a rebuild of `packages/spec`, and it is the one on disk.

**The v18 dependency move.** objectui's lockfile resolves `@objectstack/*` at `18.0.0-next.0`. `build-console.sh` injects this tree's `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/client`, which are also `18.0.0-next.0`. The build and every assertion above held, so the hop does not break the Console Pin Gate build against current `main`.

## Artefacts that travel with the pin

- **Console changeset.** `scripts/bump-objectui.sh b9814b334d8a… --no-commit` generated `.changeset/console-b9814b334d8a.md`.
  - `@objectstack/console` **minor**, the level the script derived.
  - 31 releasing entries, 4 release-nothing changesets, and 4 commits with no changeset, listed by subject.
  - Four entries are breaking by their authors' annotation. The digest marked all four, including objectui#12242's warning-sign heading.
  - The script's ADR-0087 placeholder is answered `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, the disposition earlier pin hops used. Each breaking entry is answered against this tree:
    - objectui#12030: this tree is the 18 line, and nothing here depends on `@object-ui/*`.
    - objectui#12242 (fields): `FieldSchema` refuses a field-level `pattern`, `pattern_message` and `validate` as unrecognized keys.
    - objectui#12242 (types): nothing here depends on `@object-ui/types`, and nothing declares `type: 'geolocation'`.
    - objectui#12273: nothing here reads the two retired breadcrumb keys.
  - `Clause-②: no` is added to the changeset.
- **SDUI manifest.** `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` wrote 107 components, sha256 `7911e7559d96…`. The record is re-recorded at the pin. Values moved:
  - `record:details`, `record:highlights` and `record:quick_actions` gain the `dataSource` input. The spec already declares it on every page component (objectui#12294).
  - The `object-grid` `emptyState` and `filter` descriptions and the `record:details` `sections` description changed.
  - No component was added or removed.
- **Lockstep record.** `pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` re-records `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` at `b9814b334d8a`. Across the hop, objectui's `packages/sdui-parser` changed only in `package.json`, the dependency range; `src/` is byte-identical. `check:sdui-lockstep` passes (214 grammar lines, 25 codes, the predicate). **No parser port is owed.**

## `packages/spec/src/**` hunks, and why each is true at the new pin

**1. Describe text this hop flips.** Each is measured at objectui `b9814b334` and cites the objectui line that reads the key.

- `view.zod.ts`, `EmptyStateSchema.link`: the `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` marker is dropped.
  - `ListView` hands `ListEmptyState` the link (`ListView.tsx:5716`). `ListEmptyState` draws it beside the add-record action (`ListEmptyState.tsx:153`) in the empty branch of the `grid` and `gallery` visualizations.
  - `ObjectGrid` draws it in `DataEmptyState`'s action slot (`ObjectGrid.tsx:6897-6899`).
  - The docblock records the measurement.
- `page.zod.ts`, `interfaceConfig.emptyState`: the marker is dropped. `InterfaceListPage` hands `ListView` `cfg.emptyState ?? view.emptyState` (`InterfaceListPage.tsx:509`).
- `component.zod.ts`, `record:details` `sections[].count`: the `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` marker is dropped, and so is the "renders as literal text" sentence.
  - `RecordDetailsRenderer` fills the hole after translation (`record-details.tsx:904-906`, objectui#12192, `c08c9332a`).
  - The member's own record had prescribed exactly this drop.
- `component.zod.ts`, the `object-grid` `emptyState` describe: it now reads `{ title, message, icon, link }`, because the grid draws `link` at this pin (objectui#12270). The docblock gains one paragraph.

**Kept, measured:**
- `parentDataSource` keeps its PLANNED marker: `git grep parentDataSource` reads 0 at `b9814b334`, against a lit control `relationshipValueField`.
- The page API binding (`page.zod.ts:503`) keeps its marker, per the card body: objectui#12325 is on hold.

**Ledger.** The two liveness notes (`liveness/view.json` `emptyState`, `liveness/page.json` `interfaceConfig`) that excluded these members from their `live` rows now say both are covered.

**2. Pin-citation re-measure.** `check:objectui-pin-citations --verify-anchors` reports 55 asserting citations matching `b9814b334` and 13 quoted anchors verified against objectui at `b9814b334`.

- Every objectui file named in every asserting record was resolved and checked against the hop's 397 changed paths.
- **Records that cite only byte-identical files** (22 rows by script, plus the action-group `params` record by hand) each gain the standard hop sentence.
- **Records that cite a changed file** had every cited line mapped through `git diff -U0` and re-read. Every anchor moved byte-identical or held:
  - the batch-conformance selection block still hashes to `c88443302d40`;
  - the functional-completeness `calendar` / `gantt` / `timeline` / `map` rows;
  - the record-block `requiredPermissions` record. objectui#12294 now wraps three renderers in `recordBindingBlock`, and the hop sentence says what that adds for a BOUND block;
  - the action vocabulary, `object-grid` `keyboardNavigation` (twice) and `emptyState` records;
  - the kanban `limit` (spec and test) records, and the calendar `navigation` record;
  - the gantt, tree, tree-shell-count and data-list records.
- **The `keyboardNavigation` count** still finds 15 hit lines, now against 4 for the control: objectui#12292 added a fourth `schema.editable` read.
- **The `map` block record** (historical form, quoted anchors) redded three anchors on this hop. `case 'map':` moved `2479` → `2460`, `ObjectMapConfigSchema` `2523` → `2520`, and `LIST_VIEW_LOCAL_OVERRIDES` `1506` → `1503`. Each is byte-identical, and a RE-READ sentence was added.
- **One un-stamped "at the pin" anchor in the same file** (`data-objectstack/src/index.ts:5066-5077`, the `translateFilterArray` arm) moved to `5180-5191` and was re-pointed.
- **The six migration entries.** Their corpus counts were re-taken with `git grep -o -F`, which reproduces every `1fb1ced36243` figure.
  - Corpus: 8743 files.
  - A superset of 98 names reads 0: the 13 lifecycle, 31 metrics and 37 tracing exports, plus 17 further names. The exceptions are the unrelated `Span` 519 and `SpanSchema` 57, both unchanged.
  - The controls moved: `objectstack` 18601 → 18854, `@objectstack/spec` 7679 → 7819, `timeout` 1700 → 1750, `tenant` 1415 → 1420.
- `FormField.span`'s describe stamp moves to `b9814b334d8a`: `form.tsx`, `autoLayout.ts` and `field-type-alias.ts` are byte-identical.
- `content/docs/references/ui/{view,page,component}.mdx` were regenerated by `check:generated --fix`, which regenerated only `check:docs`.
- Changeset `.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-b9814b334d8a.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `Clause-②: no`.

**No key, default, enum member or export moves.** `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:export-origins` and `check:declaration-map` are all green on the rebuilt dist.

## Smoke boot, against this branch's built console

I ran `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 39523` from this worktree.

- `check-dev-prereqs` reported 69 packages present.
- `GET /api/v1/health` answered 200 (`status: ok`, version `18.0.0-next.0`) 12 s after launch.
- `GET /_console/` answered 200 (18552 bytes), and its entry script `./assets/index-BnJvRUm1.js` answered 200.
- The served stamp `/_console/.objectui-sha` reads `b9814b334d8aebac43dd2b04a2003963aec3cc6e`.
- The served `/_console/sdui.manifest.json` hashes to `7911e7559d96…`, the recorded sha256.

I stopped the server by the two PIDs this run recorded, and the port was free afterwards. No browser pass was run, as the card orders.

## Verification, at `8aa9b01d9`

- **Package tests.**
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 673 files, 20461 passed, 1 todo.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/sdui-parser test`: 14 files, 225 passed.
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths, off the merge base) derived 126 commands. Each was run with its exit code recorded, and `--ran` reports "126 derived, 126 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- **Three gates first exited 3** (prerequisite not met) and were re-run green:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: its fixture commit `621a48760788` was fetched (48 cases);
  - `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: after a full `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs`.
- **One gate exits 1 and is not this diff's.** `pnpm check:platform-checklist` reports 8 problems (ABSENT SYMBOL in `areas/access-security.json`, `attachments-storage.json` and `search.json`). The same 8 problems appear on an unmodified worktree at the base `5656c5638`, and this diff touches none of those files. The gate is kept out of per-PR CI and runs as a daily watchdog.
- **NOT MEASURED: repo-wide `pnpm lint`.** Reason: it is a CI-owned run; this PR adds no lint-relevant code.

## Acceptance notes

- **`scripts/build-console.sh` ignores an `OBJECTUI_ROOT` that is a linked git worktree.**
  - It tests `-d "${OBJECTUI_ROOT}/.git"`, and a worktree's `.git` is a file. Measured on this run: `OBJECTUI_ROOT=/home/user/objectui-pin-23392` (a detached worktree) printed "Using objectui source at /home/user/objectui" and fell back to the sibling checkout without a word.
  - `bump-objectui.sh` already spells the test `-e`, and its own comment says why.
  - Harmless here, because both trees share one object store. Reported to the PM seat; not fixed in this PR.
- **The spec side's remaining follow-up from objectui#12270** stays with the spec seat (objectui comment `6132635356` names it): offering `interfaceConfig.emptyState` in the page form and deleting its omit row in `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`. That row's `why` still says "PLANNED, not yet rendered". It is outside this hop's file surface.
- **objectstack#23406 (Studio's first save sends `If-None-Match: *`) is not addressed here.** No browser pass was ordered, so no first-party path to the sealed-item remedy was measured on this hop.
